8.kjv: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
8.bsb: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.

8.web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities, and bore our diseases.”
8.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
8.bsb: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took on our infirmities and carried our diseases.”

8.web: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.
8.kjv: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
8.bsb: When Jesus saw a large crowd around Him, He gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea.

8.web: A scribe came, and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
8.kjv: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
8.bsb: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”

8.web: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”
8.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
8.bsb: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”

8.web: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
8.kjv: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
8.bsb: Another of His disciples requested, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”

8.web: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”
8.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
8.bsb: But Jesus told him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”

8.web: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.
8.kjv: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
8.bsb: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.

8.web: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves, but he was asleep.
8.kjv: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
8.bsb: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves; but Jesus was sleeping.

8.web: They came to him, and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”
8.kjv: And his disciples came to him , and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
8.bsb: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”

8.web: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.
8.kjv: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
8.bsb: “You of little faith,” Jesus replied, “why are you so afraid?” Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm.

8.web: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
8.kjv: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
8.bsb: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!”

8.web: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.
8.kjv: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
8.bsb: When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, He was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.

8.web: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”
8.kjv: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
8.bsb: “What do You want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”

8.web: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.
8.kjv: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
8.bsb: In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.

8.web: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”
8.kjv: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
8.bsb: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”

8.web: He said to them, “Go!” They came out, and went into the herd of pigs: and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea, and died in the water.
8.kjv: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
8.bsb: “Go!” He told them. So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.

8.web: Those who fed them fled, and went away into the city, and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.
8.kjv: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
8.bsb: Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.

8.web: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
8.kjv: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
8.bsb: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.

9.web: He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.
9.kjv: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
9.bsb: Jesus got into a boat, crossed over, and came to His own town.

9.web: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”
9.kjv: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
9.bsb: Just then some men brought to Him a paralytic lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven.”

9.web: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”
9.kjv: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
9.bsb: On seeing this, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming!”

9.web: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
9.kjv: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
9.bsb: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, “Why do you harbor evil in your hearts?

9.web: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk?’
9.kjv: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
9.bsb: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk?’

9.web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins-” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
9.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
9.bsb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” Then He said to the paralytic, “Get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”

9.web: He arose and departed to his house.
9.kjv: And he arose, and departed to his house.
9.bsb: And the man got up and went home.

9.web: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
9.kjv: But when the multitudes saw it , they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
9.bsb: When the crowds saw this, they were filled with awe and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

9.web: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
9.kjv: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
9.bsb: As Jesus went on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him, and Matthew got up and followed Him.

9.web: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
9.kjv: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
9.bsb: Later, as Jesus was dining at Matthew’s house, many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with Him and His disciples.

9.web: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
9.kjv: And when the Pharisees saw it , they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
9.bsb: When the Pharisees saw this, they asked His disciples, “Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

9.web: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
9.kjv: But when Jesus heard that , he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
9.bsb: On hearing this, Jesus said, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.

9.web: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
9.kjv: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
9.bsb: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”

9.web: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”
9.kjv: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
9.bsb: At that time John’s disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why is it that we and the Pharisees fast so often, but Your disciples do not fast?”

9.web: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
9.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
9.bsb: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while He is with them? But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.

9.web: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.
9.kjv: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
9.bsb: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. For the patch will pull away from the garment, and a worse tear will result.

9.web: Neither do people put new wine into old wine skins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wine skins, and both are preserved.”
9.kjv: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
9.bsb: Neither do men pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.”

9.web: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
9.kjv: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
9.bsb: While Jesus was saying these things, a synagogue leader came and knelt before Him. “My daughter has just died,” he said. “But come and place Your hand on her, and she will live.”

9.web: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
9.kjv: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
9.bsb: So Jesus got up and went with him, along with His disciples.

9.web: Behold, a woman who had an issue of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
9.kjv: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him , and touched the hem of his garment:
9.bsb: Suddenly a woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years came up behind Him and touched the fringe of His cloak.

9.web: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
9.kjv: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
9.bsb: She said to herself, “If only I touch His cloak, I will be healed.”

9.web: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.
9.kjv: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
9.bsb: Jesus turned and saw her. “Take courage, daughter,” He said, “your faith has healed you.” And the woman was cured from that very hour.

9.web: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the flute players, and the crowd in noisy disorder,
9.kjv: And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
9.bsb: When Jesus entered the house of the synagogue leader, He saw the flute players and the noisy crowd.

9.web: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.
9.kjv: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
9.bsb: “Go away,” He told them. “The girl is not dead, but asleep.” And they laughed at Him.

9.web: But when the crowd was put out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
9.kjv: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
9.bsb: After the crowd had been put outside, Jesus went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.

9.web: The report of this went out into all that land.
9.kjv: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
9.bsb: And the news about this spread throughout that region.

9.web: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”
9.kjv: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.
9.bsb: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed Him, crying out, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!”

9.web: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”
9.kjv: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
9.bsb: After Jesus had entered the house, the blind men came to Him. “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” He asked. “Yes, Lord,” they answered.

9.web: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”
9.kjv: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
9.bsb: Then He touched their eyes and said, “According to your faith will it be done to you.”

9.web: Their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
9.kjv: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it .
9.bsb: And their eyes were opened. Jesus warned them sternly, “See that no one finds out about this!”

9.web: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
9.kjv: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
9.bsb: But they went out and spread the news about Him throughout the land.

9.web: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
9.kjv: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
9.bsb: As they were leaving, a demon-possessed man who was mute was brought to Jesus.

9.web: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
9.kjv: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
9.bsb: And when the demon had been driven out, the man began to speak. The crowds were amazed and said, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

9.web: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
9.kjv: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
9.bsb: But the Pharisees said, “It is by the prince of demons that He drives out demons.”

9.web: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
9.kjv: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
9.bsb: Jesus went through all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness.

9.web: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
9.kjv: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
9.bsb: When He saw the crowds, He was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.

9.web: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
9.kjv: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
9.bsb: Then He said to His disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.

9.web: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
9.kjv: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
9.bsb: Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.”

10.web: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.
10.kjv: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
10.bsb: And calling His twelve disciples to Him, Jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they could drive them out and heal every disease and sickness.

10.web: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;
10.kjv: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
10.bsb: These are the names of the twelve apostles: first Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew; James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;

10.web: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;
10.kjv: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
10.bsb: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;

10.web: Simon the Canaanite; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
10.kjv: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
10.bsb: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.

10.web: Jesus sent these twelve out, and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.
10.kjv: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
10.bsb: These twelve Jesus sent out with the following instructions: “Do not go onto the road of the Gentiles or enter any town of the Samaritans.

10.web: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
10.kjv: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
10.bsb: Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.

10.web: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’
10.kjv: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
10.bsb: As you go, preach this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven is near.’

10.web: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
10.kjv: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
10.bsb: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give.

10.web: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
10.kjv: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
10.bsb: Do not carry any gold or silver or copper in your belts.

10.web: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor shoes, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
10.kjv: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
10.bsb: Take no bag for the road, or second tunic, or sandals, or staff; for the worker is worthy of his provisions.

10.web: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy; and stay there until you go on.
10.kjv: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
10.bsb: Whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on.

10.web: As you enter into the household, greet it.
10.kjv: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
10.bsb: As you enter the home, greet its occupants.

10.web: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
10.kjv: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
10.bsb: If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it; but if it is not, let your peace return to you.

10.web: Whoever doesn’t receive you, nor hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.
10.kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
10.bsb: And if anyone will not welcome you or heed your words, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that home or town.

10.web: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
10.kjv: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
10.bsb: Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.

10.web: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
10.kjv: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
10.bsb: Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.

10.web: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
10.kjv: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
10.bsb: But beware of men; for they will hand you over to their councils and flog you in their synagogues.

10.web: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
10.kjv: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
10.bsb: On My account, you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles.

10.web: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.
10.kjv: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
10.bsb: But when they hand you over, do not worry about how to respond or what to say. In that hour you will be given what to say.

10.web: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
10.kjv: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
10.bsb: For it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.

10.web: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
10.kjv: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
10.bsb: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.

10.web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
10.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
10.bsb: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.

10.web: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel, until the Son of Man has come.
10.kjv: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
10.bsb: When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next. Truly I tell you, you will not reach all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.

10.web: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.
10.kjv: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
10.bsb: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.

10.web: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!
10.kjv: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
10.bsb: It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!

10.web: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed; and hidden that will not be known.
10.kjv: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
10.bsb: So do not be afraid of them. For there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.

10.web: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
10.kjv: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
10.bsb: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the housetops.

10.web: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
10.kjv: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
10.bsb: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

10.web: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls on the ground apart from your Father’s will,
10.kjv: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
10.bsb: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.

10.web: but the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
10.kjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
10.bsb: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

10.web: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
10.kjv: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
10.bsb: So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

10.web: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, him I will also confess before my Father who is in heaven.
10.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
10.bsb: Therefore everyone who confesses Me before men, I will also confess him before My Father in heaven.

10.web: But whoever denies me before men, him I will also deny before my Father who is in heaven.
10.kjv: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
10.bsb: But whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny him before My Father in heaven.

10.web: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
10.kjv: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
10.bsb: Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.

10.web: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
10.kjv: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
10.bsb: For I have come to turn ‘a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

10.web: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.
10.kjv: And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.
10.bsb: A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.’

10.web: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.
10.kjv: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
10.bsb: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me;

10.web: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me, isn’t worthy of me.
10.kjv: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
10.bsb: and anyone who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.

10.web: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.
10.kjv: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
10.bsb: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.

10.web: He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
10.kjv: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
10.bsb: He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives the One who sent Me.

10.web: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
10.kjv: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man’s reward.
10.bsb: Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward, and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

10.web: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you he will in no way lose his reward.”
10.kjv: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
10.bsb: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.”

11.web: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.
11.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
11.bsb: After Jesus had finished instructing His twelve disciples, He went on from there to teach and preach in their cities.

11.web: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples
11.kjv: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
11.bsb: Meanwhile John heard in prison about the works of Christ, and he sent his disciples

11.web: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”
11.kjv: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
11.bsb: to ask Him, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”

11.web: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:
11.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
11.bsb: Jesus replied, “Go back and report to John what you hear and see:

11.web: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
11.kjv: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
11.bsb: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.

11.web: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
11.kjv: And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me.
11.bsb: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.”

11.web: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
11.kjv: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
11.bsb: As John’s disciples were leaving, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?

11.web: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
11.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
11.bsb: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear fine clothing are found in kings’ palaces.

11.web: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
11.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
11.bsb: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.

11.web: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
11.kjv: For this is he , of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
11.bsb: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’

11.web: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.
11.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
11.bsb: Truly I tell you, among those born of women there has risen no one greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

11.web: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.
11.kjv: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
11.bsb: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been subject to violence, and the violent lay claim to it.

11.web: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
11.kjv: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
11.bsb: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.

11.web: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.
11.kjv: And if ye will receive it , this is Elias, which was for to come.
11.bsb: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.

11.web: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
11.kjv: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
11.bsb: He who has ears, let him hear.

11.web: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions
11.kjv: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
11.bsb: To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:

11.web: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’
11.kjv: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
11.bsb: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’

11.web: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’
11.kjv: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
11.bsb: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’

11.web: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”
11.kjv: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
11.bsb: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is vindicated by her actions.”

11.web: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.
11.kjv: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
11.bsb: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities in which most of His miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.

11.web: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
11.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
11.bsb: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

11.web: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
11.kjv: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
11.bsb: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

11.web: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.
11.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
11.bsb: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.

11.web: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom, on the day of judgment, than for you.”
11.kjv: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
11.bsb: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”

11.web: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.
11.kjv: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
11.bsb: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.

11.web: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.
11.kjv: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
11.bsb: Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.

11.web: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son, and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.
11.kjv: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
11.bsb: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.

11.web: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
11.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
11.bsb: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

11.web: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
11.kjv: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
11.bsb: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

11.web: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
11.kjv: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
11.bsb: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”

12.web: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
12.kjv: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
12.bsb: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick the heads of grain and eat them.

12.web: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”
12.kjv: But when the Pharisees saw it , they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
12.bsb: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to Him, “Look, Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath.”

12.web: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did, when he was hungry, and those who were with him;
12.kjv: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
12.bsb: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

12.web: how he entered into God’s house, and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for those who were with him, but only for the priests?
12.kjv: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
12.bsb: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.

12.web: Or have you not read in the law, that on the Sabbath day, the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath, and are guiltless?
12.kjv: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
12.bsb: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are innocent?

12.web: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.
12.kjv: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
12.bsb: But I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.

12.web: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.
12.kjv: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
12.bsb: If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.

12.web: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
12.kjv: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
12.bsb: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

12.web: He departed there, and went into their synagogue.
12.kjv: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
12.bsb: Moving on from there, Jesus entered their synagogue,

12.web: And behold there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” that they might accuse him.
12.kjv: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
12.bsb: and a man with a withered hand was there. In order to accuse Jesus, they asked Him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

12.web: He said to them, “What man is there among you, who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it, and lift it out?
12.kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
12.bsb: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?

12.web: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”
12.kjv: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
12.bsb: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”

12.web: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.
12.kjv: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
12.bsb: Then Jesus said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored to full use, just like the other.

12.web: But the Pharisees went out, and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.
12.kjv: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
12.bsb: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.

12.web: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
12.kjv: But when Jesus knew it , he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
12.bsb: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them all,

12.web: and commanded them that they should not make him known:
12.kjv: And charged them that they should not make him known:
12.bsb: warning them not to make Him known.

12.web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
12.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
12.bsb: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:

12.web: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen; my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
12.kjv: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
12.bsb: “Here is My Servant, whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the nations.

12.web: He will not strive, nor shout; neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.
12.kjv: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
12.bsb: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear His voice in the streets.

12.web: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
12.kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
12.bsb: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish, till He leads justice to victory.

12.web: In his name, the nations will hope.”
12.kjv: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
12.bsb: In His name the nations will put their hope.”

12.web: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.
12.kjv: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
12.bsb: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that he could speak and see.

12.web: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”
12.kjv: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
12.bsb: The crowds were astounded and asked, “Could this be the Son of David?”

12.web: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons, except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
12.kjv: But when the Pharisees heard it , they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
12.bsb: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.”

12.web: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
12.kjv: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
12.bsb: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.

12.web: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
12.kjv: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
12.bsb: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?

12.web: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
12.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
12.bsb: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.

12.web: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.
12.kjv: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
12.bsb: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

12.web: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.
12.kjv: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
12.bsb: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.

12.web: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.
12.kjv: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
12.bsb: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.

12.web: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.
12.kjv: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
12.bsb: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.

12.web: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, neither in this age, nor in that which is to come.
12.kjv: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
12.bsb: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the one to come.

12.web: “Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.
12.kjv: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
12.bsb: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad; for a tree is known by its fruit.

12.web: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.
12.kjv: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
12.bsb: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart, the mouth speaks.

12.web: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.
12.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
12.bsb: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.

12.web: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
12.kjv: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
12.bsb: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.

12.web: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
12.kjv: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
12.bsb: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”

12.web: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”
12.kjv: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
12.bsb: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to Him, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from You.”

12.web: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
12.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
12.bsb: Jesus replied, “A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.

12.web: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
12.kjv: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
12.bsb: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

12.web: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.
12.kjv: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
12.bsb: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.

12.web: The queen of the south will rise up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.
12.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
12.bsb: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.

12.web: When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places, seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.
12.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
12.bsb: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.

12.web: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came out,’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
12.kjv: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
12.bsb: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ On its return, it finds the house vacant, swept clean, and put in order.

12.web: Then he goes, and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”
12.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
12.bsb: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there; and the final plight of that man is worse than the first. So will it be with this wicked generation.”

12.web: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
12.kjv: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
12.bsb: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, His mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to Him.

12.web: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”
12.kjv: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
12.bsb: Someone told Him, “Look, Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to You.”

12.web: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
12.kjv: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
12.bsb: But Jesus replied, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?”

12.web: He stretched out his hand towards his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
12.kjv: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
12.bsb: Pointing to His disciples, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers.

12.web: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
12.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
12.bsb: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother.”

13.web: On that day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the seaside.
13.kjv: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
13.bsb: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the sea.

13.web: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.
13.kjv: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
13.bsb: Such large crowds gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat down, while all the people stood on the shore.

13.web: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.
13.kjv: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
13.bsb: And He told them many things in parables, saying, “A farmer went out to sow his seed.

13.web: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
13.kjv: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
13.bsb: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.

13.web: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.
13.kjv: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
13.bsb: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.

13.web: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.
13.kjv: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
13.bsb: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.

13.web: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.
13.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
13.bsb: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings.

13.web: Others fell on good soil, and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.
13.kjv: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
13.bsb: Still other seed fell on good soil and produced a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.

13.web: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
13.kjv: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
13.bsb: He who has ears, let him hear.”

13.web: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
13.kjv: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
13.bsb: Then the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why do You speak to the people in parables?”

13.web: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
13.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
13.bsb: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.

13.web: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.
13.kjv: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
13.bsb: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.

13.web: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.
13.kjv: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
13.bsb: This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’

13.web: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive:
13.kjv: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
13.bsb: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled: ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.

13.web: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again; and I would heal them.’
13.kjv: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
13.bsb: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’

13.web: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
13.kjv: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
13.bsb: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.

13.web: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.
13.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them ; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
13.bsb: For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous men longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.

13.web: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.
13.kjv: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
13.bsb: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:

13.web: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom, and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes, and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.
13.kjv: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one , and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
13.bsb: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.

13.web: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;
13.kjv: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
13.bsb: The seed sown on rocky ground is the one who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.

13.web: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
13.kjv: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
13.bsb: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.

13.web: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
13.kjv: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
13.bsb: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

13.web: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit, and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”
13.kjv: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it ; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
13.bsb: But the seed sown on good soil is the one who hears the word and understands it. He indeed bears fruit and produces a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.”

13.web: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
13.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
13.bsb: Jesus put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.

13.web: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.
13.kjv: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
13.bsb: But while everyone was asleep, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and slipped away.

13.web: But when the blade sprang up and produced fruit, then the darnel weeds appeared also.
13.kjv: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
13.bsb: When the wheat sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.

13.web: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’
13.kjv: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
13.bsb: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’

13.web: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’
13.kjv: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
13.bsb: ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. So the servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’

13.web: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.
13.kjv: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
13.bsb: ‘No,’ he said, ‘if you pull the weeds now, you might uproot the wheat with them.

13.web: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”
13.kjv: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
13.bsb: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat into my barn.’”

13.web: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field;
13.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
13.bsb: He put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man planted in his field.

13.web: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”
13.kjv: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
13.bsb: Although it is the smallest of all seeds, yet it grows into the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.”

13.web: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”
13.kjv: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
13.bsb: He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”

13.web: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,
13.kjv: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
13.bsb: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables. He did not tell them anything without using a parable.

13.web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”
13.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
13.bsb: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: “I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world.”

13.web: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
13.kjv: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
13.bsb: Then Jesus dismissed the crowds and went into the house. His disciples came to Him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.”

13.web: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,
13.kjv: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
13.bsb: He replied, “The One who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.

13.web: the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the children of the Kingdom; and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.
13.kjv: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one ;
13.bsb: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,

13.web: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
13.kjv: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
