13.bsb: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.

13.web: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.
13.kjv: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
13.bsb: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of the age.

13.web: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and those who do iniquity,
13.kjv: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
13.bsb: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.

13.web: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
13.kjv: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
13.bsb: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

13.web: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
13.kjv: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
13.bsb: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.

13.web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found, and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.
13.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
13.bsb: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.

13.web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
13.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
13.bsb: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.

13.web: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
13.kjv: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
13.bsb: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.

13.web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,
13.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
13.bsb: Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and caught all kinds of fish.

13.web: which, when it was filled, they drew up on the beach. They sat down, and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.
13.kjv: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
13.bsb: When it was full, the men pulled it ashore. Then they sat down and sorted the good fish into containers, but threw the bad away.

13.web: So will it be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
13.kjv: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
13.bsb: So will it be at the end of the age: The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous,

13.web: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.”
13.kjv: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
13.bsb: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

13.web: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
13.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
13.bsb: Have you understood all these things?” “Yes,” they answered.

13.web: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”
13.kjv: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
13.bsb: Then He told them, “For this reason, every scribe who has been discipled in the kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”

13.web: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
13.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
13.bsb: When Jesus had finished these parables, He withdrew from that place.

13.web: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom, and these mighty works?
13.kjv: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
13.bsb: Coming to His hometown, He taught the people in their synagogue, and they were astonished. “Where did this man get such wisdom and miraculous powers?” they asked.

13.web: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers, James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
13.kjv: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
13.bsb: “Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t His mother’s name Mary, and aren’t His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?

13.web: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
13.kjv: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
13.bsb: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?”

13.web: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and in his own house.”
13.kjv: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
13.bsb: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”

13.web: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
13.kjv: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
13.bsb: And He did not do many miracles there, because of their unbelief.

14.web: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
14.kjv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
14.bsb: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus

14.web: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
14.kjv: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
14.bsb: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”

14.web: For Herod had laid hold of John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
14.kjv: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife.
14.bsb: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,

14.web: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
14.kjv: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
14.bsb: because John had been telling him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

14.web: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
14.kjv: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
14.bsb: Although Herod wanted to kill John, he was afraid of the people, because they regarded John as a prophet.

14.web: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.
14.kjv: But when Herod’s birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
14.bsb: On Herod’s birthday, however, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod

14.web: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.
14.kjv: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
14.bsb: so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she asked.

14.web: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
14.kjv: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist’s head in a charger.
14.bsb: Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.”

14.web: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths, and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,
14.kjv: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath’s sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her .
14.bsb: The king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his guests, he ordered that her wish be granted

14.web: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
14.kjv: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
14.bsb: and sent to have John beheaded in the prison.

14.web: His head was brought on a platter, and given to the young lady: and she brought it to her mother.
14.kjv: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
14.bsb: John’s head was brought in on a platter and presented to the girl, who carried it to her mother.

14.web: His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it; and they went and told Jesus.
14.kjv: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
14.bsb: Then John’s disciples came and took his body and buried it. And they went and informed Jesus.

14.web: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
14.kjv: When Jesus heard of it , he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof , they followed him on foot out of the cities.
14.bsb: When Jesus heard about John, He withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. But the crowds found out about it and followed Him on foot from the towns.

14.web: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them, and healed their sick.
14.kjv: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
14.bsb: When He stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

14.web: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”
14.kjv: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
14.bsb: When evening came, the disciples came to Him and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late. Dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.”

14.web: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
14.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
14.bsb: “They do not need to go away,” Jesus replied. “You give them something to eat.”

14.web: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
14.kjv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
14.bsb: “We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered.

14.web: He said, “Bring them here to me.”
14.kjv: He said, Bring them hither to me.
14.bsb: “Bring them here to Me,” Jesus said.

14.web: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
14.kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
14.bsb: And He directed the crowds to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, He spoke a blessing. Then He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.

14.web: They all ate, and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
14.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
14.bsb: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

14.web: Those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
14.kjv: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
14.bsb: About five thousand men were fed, in addition to women and children.

14.web: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
14.kjv: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
14.bsb: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to the other side, while He dismissed the crowds.

14.web: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
14.kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
14.bsb: After He had sent them away, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. When evening came, He was there alone,

14.web: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
14.kjv: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
14.bsb: but the boat was already far from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.

14.web: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.
14.kjv: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
14.bsb: During the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea.

14.web: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.
14.kjv: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
14.bsb: When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were terrified. “It’s a ghost!” they said, and cried out in fear.

14.web: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
14.kjv: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
14.bsb: But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”

14.web: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”
14.kjv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
14.bsb: “Lord, if it is You,” Peter replied, “command me to come to You on the water.”

14.web: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat, and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.
14.kjv: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
14.bsb: “Come,” said Jesus. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water, and came toward Jesus.

14.web: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
14.kjv: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
14.bsb: But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!”

14.web: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
14.kjv: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
14.bsb: Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter. “You of little faith,” He said, “why did you doubt?”

14.web: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
14.kjv: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
14.bsb: And when they had climbed back into the boat, the wind died down.

14.web: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
14.kjv: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
14.bsb: Then those who were in the boat worshiped Him, saying, “Truly You are the Son of God!”

14.web: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
14.kjv: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
14.bsb: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret.

14.web: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region, and brought to him all who were sick;
14.kjv: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
14.bsb: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding region. People brought all the sick to Him

14.web: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
14.kjv: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
14.bsb: and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak. And all who touched Him were healed.

15.web: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,
15.kjv: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
15.bsb: Then some Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked,

15.web: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
15.kjv: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
15.bsb: “Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They do not wash their hands before they eat.”

15.web: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?
15.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
15.bsb: Jesus replied, “And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?

15.web: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
15.kjv: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
15.bsb: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’

15.web: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”
15.kjv: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
15.bsb: But you say that if anyone says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is a gift devoted to God,’

15.web: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.
15.kjv: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free . Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
15.bsb: he need not honor his father or mother with it. Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.

15.web: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
15.kjv: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
15.bsb: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you:

15.web: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
15.kjv: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
15.bsb: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.

15.web: And in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”
15.kjv: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
15.bsb: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’”

15.web: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.
15.kjv: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
15.bsb: Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “Listen and understand.

15.web: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”
15.kjv: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
15.bsb: A man is not defiled by what enters his mouth, but by what comes out of it.”

15.web: Then the disciples came, and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?”
15.kjv: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
15.bsb: Then the disciples came to Him and said, “Are You aware that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?”

15.web: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.
15.kjv: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
15.bsb: But Jesus replied, “Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by its roots.

15.web: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
15.kjv: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
15.bsb: Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”

15.web: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”
15.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
15.bsb: Peter said to Him, “Explain this parable to us.”

15.web: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?
15.kjv: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
15.bsb: “Do you still not understand?” Jesus asked.

15.web: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly, and then out of the body?
15.kjv: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
15.bsb: “Do you not yet realize that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then is eliminated?

15.web: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.
15.kjv: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
15.bsb: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these things defile a man.

15.web: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
15.kjv: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
15.bsb: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.

15.web: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”
15.kjv: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
15.bsb: These are what defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.”

15.web: Jesus went out from there, and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.
15.kjv: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
15.bsb: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon.

15.web: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”
15.kjv: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
15.bsb: And a Canaanite woman from that region came to Him, crying out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is miserably possessed by a demon.”

15.web: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”
15.kjv: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
15.bsb: But Jesus did not answer a word. So His disciples came and urged Him, “Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us.”

15.web: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
15.kjv: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
15.bsb: He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

15.web: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”
15.kjv: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
15.bsb: The woman came and knelt before Him. “Lord, help me!” she said.

15.web: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
15.kjv: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.
15.bsb: But Jesus replied, “It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”

15.web: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”
15.kjv: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.
15.bsb: “Yes, Lord,” she said, “even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table.”

15.web: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.
15.kjv: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
15.bsb: “O woman,” Jesus answered, “your faith is great! Let it be done for you as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that very hour.

15.web: Jesus departed from there, and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.
15.kjv: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
15.bsb: Moving on from there, Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee. Then He went up on a mountain and sat down.

15.web: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,
15.kjv: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus’ feet; and he healed them:
15.bsb: Large crowds came to Him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute, and many others, and laid them at His feet, and He healed them.

15.web: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.
15.kjv: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
15.bsb: The crowd was amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled restored, the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they glorified the God of Israel.

15.web: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”
15.kjv: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him , and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
15.bsb: Then Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may faint along the way.”

15.web: The disciples said to him, “Where should we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”
15.kjv: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
15.bsb: The disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could we find enough bread to feed such a large crowd?”

15.web: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
15.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
15.bsb: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied, “and a few small fish.”

15.web: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
15.kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
15.bsb: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground.

15.web: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
15.kjv: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them , and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
15.bsb: Taking the seven loaves and the fish, He gave thanks and broke them. Then He gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.

15.web: They all ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.
15.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
15.bsb: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

15.web: Those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.
15.kjv: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
15.bsb: A total of four thousand men were fed, in addition to women and children.

15.web: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.
15.kjv: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
15.bsb: After Jesus had dismissed the crowds, He got into the boat and went to the region of Magadan.

16.web: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
16.kjv: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
16.bsb: Then the Pharisees and Sadducees came and tested Jesus by asking Him to show them a sign from heaven.

16.web: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’
16.kjv: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
16.bsb: But He replied, “When evening comes, you say, ‘The weather will be fair, for the sky is red,’

16.web: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!
16.kjv: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
16.bsb: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but not the signs of the times.

16.web: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them, and departed.
16.kjv: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
16.bsb: A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.” Then He left them and went away.

16.web: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.
16.kjv: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
16.bsb: When they crossed to the other side, the disciples forgot to take bread.

16.web: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
16.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
16.bsb: “Watch out!” Jesus told them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

16.web: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”
16.kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
16.bsb: They discussed this among themselves and concluded, “It is because we did not bring any bread.”

16.web: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, ‘because you have brought no bread?’
16.kjv: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
16.bsb: Aware of their conversation, Jesus said, “You of little faith, why are you debating among yourselves about having no bread?

16.web: Don’t you yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
16.kjv: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
16.bsb: Do you still not understand? Do you not remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?

16.web: Nor the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
16.kjv: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
16.bsb: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?

16.web: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
16.kjv: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
16.bsb: How do you not understand that I was not telling you about bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

16.web: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
16.kjv: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
16.bsb: Then they understood that He was not telling them to beware of the leaven used in bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

16.web: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”
16.kjv: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
16.bsb: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say the Son of Man is?”

16.web: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.”
16.kjv: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
16.bsb: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

16.web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”
16.kjv: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
16.bsb: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?”

16.web: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
16.kjv: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
16.bsb: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

16.web: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.
16.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
16.bsb: Jesus replied, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah! For this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by My Father in heaven.

16.web: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
16.kjv: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
16.bsb: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

16.web: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”
16.kjv: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
16.bsb: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”

16.web: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.
16.kjv: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
16.bsb: Then He admonished the disciples not to tell anyone that He was the Christ.

16.web: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
16.kjv: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
16.bsb: From that time on Jesus began to show His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and that He must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.

16.web: Peter took him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”
16.kjv: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
16.bsb: Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him. “Far be it from You, Lord!” he said. “This shall never happen to You!”

16.web: But he turned, and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”
16.kjv: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
16.bsb: But Jesus turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”

16.web: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
16.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
16.bsb: Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.

16.web: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.
16.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
16.bsb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.

16.web: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
16.kjv: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
16.bsb: What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?

16.web: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.
16.kjv: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
16.bsb: For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.

16.web: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”
16.kjv: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
16.bsb: Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom.”

17.web: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.
17.kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
17.bsb: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.

17.web: He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
17.kjv: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
17.bsb: There He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became as white as the light.

17.web: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.
17.kjv: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
17.bsb: Suddenly Moses and Elijah appeared before them, talking with Jesus.

17.web: Peter answered, and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
17.kjv: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
17.bsb: Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

17.web: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”
17.kjv: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
17.bsb: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!”

17.web: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.
17.kjv: And when the disciples heard it , they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
17.bsb: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown in terror.

17.web: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”
17.kjv: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
17.bsb: Then Jesus came over and touched them. “Get up,” He said. “Do not be afraid.”

17.web: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.
17.kjv: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
17.bsb: And when they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.

17.web: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”
17.kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
17.bsb: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, “Do not tell anyone about this vision until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.”

17.web: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
17.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
17.bsb: The disciples asked Him, “Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

17.web: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things,
17.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
17.bsb: Jesus replied, “Elijah does indeed come, and he will restore all things.

17.web: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”
17.kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
17.bsb: But I tell you that Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him whatever they wished. In the same way, the Son of Man will suffer at their hands.”

17.web: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.
17.kjv: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
17.bsb: Then the disciples understood that He was speaking to them about John the Baptist.

17.web: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him, and saying,
17.kjv: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
17.bsb: When they came to the crowd, a man came up to Jesus and knelt before Him.

17.web: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic, and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
17.kjv: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
17.bsb: “Lord, have mercy on my son,” he said. “He has seizures and is suffering terribly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.

17.web: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”
17.kjv: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
17.bsb: I brought him to Your disciples, but they could not heal him.”

17.web: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”
17.kjv: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
17.bsb: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy here to Me.”

17.web: Jesus rebuked him, the demon went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.
17.kjv: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
17.bsb: Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment.

17.web: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
17.kjv: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
17.bsb: Afterward the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”

17.web: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.
17.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
17.bsb: “Because you have so little faith,” He answered. “For truly I tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”

17.web: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”
17.kjv: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

17.web: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,
17.kjv: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
17.bsb: When they gathered together in Galilee, Jesus told them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.

17.web: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.
17.kjv: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
17.bsb: They will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised to life.” And the disciples were deeply grieved.

17.web: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”
17.kjv: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
17.bsb: After they had arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your Teacher pay the two drachmas?”

17.web: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”
17.kjv: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
17.bsb: “Yes,” he answered. When Peter entered the house, Jesus preempted him. “What do you think, Simon?” He asked. “From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs and taxes: from their own sons, or from others?”

17.web: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.
17.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
17.bsb: “From others,” Peter answered. “Then the sons are exempt,” Jesus declared.

17.web: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”
17.kjv: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
17.bsb: “But so that we may not offend them, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take the first fish you catch. When you open its mouth, you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for My tax and yours.”

18.web: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
18.kjv: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
18.bsb: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who then is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?”

18.web: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them,
18.kjv: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
18.bsb: Jesus invited a little child to stand among them.

18.web: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
18.kjv: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
18.bsb: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.

18.web: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
18.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
18.bsb: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

18.web: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,
18.kjv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
18.bsb: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me.

18.web: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him that a huge millstone should be hung around his neck, and that he should be sunk in the depths of the sea.
18.kjv: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
18.bsb: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.

18.web: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!
18.kjv: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
18.bsb: Woe to the world for the causes of sin. These stumbling blocks must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!

18.web: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off, and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
18.kjv: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
18.bsb: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life crippled or lame than to have two hands and two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.

18.web: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.
18.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
18.bsb: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.

18.web: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.
18.kjv: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
18.bsb: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.

18.web: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.
18.kjv: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

18.web: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?
18.kjv: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
18.bsb: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?

18.web: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
18.kjv: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
18.bsb: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.

18.web: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
18.kjv: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
18.bsb: In the same way, your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.

18.web: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
18.kjv: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
18.bsb: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.

18.web: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
18.kjv: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
18.bsb: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’

18.web: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.
18.kjv: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
18.bsb: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.

18.web: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
18.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
18.bsb: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.

18.web: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
18.kjv: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
18.bsb: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.

18.web: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
18.kjv: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
18.bsb: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”

18.web: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”
18.kjv: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
18.bsb: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me? Up to seven times?”

18.web: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
18.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
18.bsb: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not just seven times, but seventy-seven times!

18.web: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who wanted to reconcile accounts with his servants.
18.kjv: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
18.bsb: Because of this, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

18.web: When he had begun to reconcile, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
18.kjv: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
18.bsb: As he began the settlements, a debtor was brought to him owing ten thousand talents.

18.web: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
18.kjv: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
18.bsb: Since the man was unable to pay, the master ordered that he be sold to pay his debt, along with his wife and children and everything he owned.

18.web: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’
18.kjv: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
18.bsb: Then the servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Have patience with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’

18.web: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.
18.kjv: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
18.bsb: His master had compassion on him, forgave his debt, and released him.

18.web: “But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow servants, who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him, and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’
18.kjv: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
18.bsb: But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him, saying, ‘Pay back what you owe me!’

18.web: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
18.kjv: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
18.bsb: So his fellow servant fell down and begged him, ‘Have patience with me, and I will pay you back.’

18.web: He would not, but went and cast him into prison, until he should pay back that which was due.
18.kjv: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
18.bsb: But he refused. Instead, he went and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay his debt.

18.web: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.
18.kjv: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
18.bsb: When his fellow servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed, and they went and recounted all of this to their master.

18.web: Then his lord called him in, and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt, because you begged me.
18.kjv: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
18.bsb: Then the master summoned him and declared, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave all your debt because you begged me.

18.web: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’
18.kjv: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
18.bsb: Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had on you?’

18.web: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors, until he should pay all that was due to him.
18.kjv: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
18.bsb: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should repay all that he owed.

18.web: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”
18.kjv: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
18.bsb: That is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.”

19.web: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
19.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
19.bsb: When Jesus had finished saying these things, He left Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.

19.web: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
19.kjv: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
19.bsb: Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.

19.web: Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
19.kjv: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
19.bsb: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

19.web: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
19.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
19.bsb: Jesus answered, “Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’

19.web: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?’
19.kjv: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
19.bsb: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?

19.web: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”
19.kjv: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
19.bsb: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”

19.web: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a bill of divorce, and divorce her?”
19.kjv: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
19.bsb: “Why then,” they asked, “did Moses order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?”

19.web: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.
19.kjv: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
19.bsb: Jesus replied, “Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of your hardness of heart; but it was not this way from the beginning.

19.web: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”
19.kjv: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
19.bsb: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman, commits adultery.”

19.web: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”
19.kjv: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
19.bsb: His disciples said to Him, “If this is the case between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.”

19.web: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.
19.kjv: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
19.bsb: “Not everyone can accept this word,” He replied, “but only those to whom it has been given.

19.web: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”
19.kjv: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it , let him receive it.
19.bsb: For there are eunuchs who were born that way; others were made that way by men; and still others live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.”

19.web: Then little children were brought to him, that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
19.kjv: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
19.bsb: Then the little children were brought to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and pray for them. And the disciples rebuked those who brought them.

19.web: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
19.kjv: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
19.bsb: But Jesus said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”

19.web: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.
19.kjv: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
19.bsb: And after He had placed His hands on them, He went on from there.

19.web: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”
19.kjv: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
19.bsb: Just then a man came up to Jesus and inquired, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?”

19.web: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
19.kjv: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is , God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
19.bsb: “Why do you ask Me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”

19.web: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’
19.kjv: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
19.bsb: “Which ones?” the man asked. Jesus answered, “‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness,

19.web: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”
19.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
19.bsb: honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.’”

19.web: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”
19.kjv: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
19.bsb: “All these I have kept,” said the young man. “What do I still lack?”

19.web: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”
19.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
19.bsb: Jesus told him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”

19.web: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.
19.kjv: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
19.bsb: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.

19.web: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.
19.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
19.bsb: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Truly I tell you, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.

19.web: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
19.kjv: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
19.bsb: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”

19.web: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
19.kjv: When his disciples heard it , they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
19.bsb: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”

19.web: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
19.kjv: But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
19.bsb: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

19.web: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?”
19.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
19.bsb: “Look,” Peter replied, “we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?”

19.web: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
19.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
19.bsb: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, in the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

19.web: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.
19.kjv: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
19.bsb: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.

19.web: But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.
19.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
19.bsb: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.

20.web: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
20.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
20.bsb: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.

20.web: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
20.kjv: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
20.bsb: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.

20.web: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.
20.kjv: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
20.bsb: About the third hour he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.

20.web: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.
20.kjv: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
